reason: A document-processing plugin that uploads or references local files, extracts supported formats into text, and attaches that content to the next chat message.

summaries.zh: 用于上传或引用本地文本、代码、Word、Excel 和 PDF 文件，将解析出的文本附加到下一条对话消息中。
summaries.en: Uploads or references local text, code, Word, Excel, and PDF files, extracts their text, and attaches it to the next chat message.

capabilities: text extraction from supported text, Word, Excel, and PDF files
workspace file listing and reading through @ references
injection of parsed file content into chat messages
optional persistence of pending parsed file content
